sources.label: NAUR LesBin - Diamond Dust / Light Rampant - Partner Swap DD4/4 + EW Light Rampant

steps.title: Arc up: supports north, DPS south
steps.rule: Line up in an arc just inside the inner circle. Supports north, west to east H1, H2, MT, OT; DPS south, west to east R1, R2, M1, M2.

steps.title: Puddle players to the east and west walls
steps.rule: If you have the purple puddle marker, go to the wall. Of the two puddle players, the one earlier in R1, H1, R2, H2, M1, MT, M2, OT takes the west wall, the other the east wall.

steps.title: Tethers: make the hexagon
steps.cue: Chain tethers appear on the other six
steps.rule: The six tethered players stand 7m out in a hexagon: three north (north-west, north, north-east) and three south (south-west, south, south-east), keeping the arc order and closing the gaps the puddle players left. If one side still has four, the extra one moves clockwise to the other side: OT drops to the south-east spot, or R1 climbs to the north-west spot.

steps.title: Cross into the towers
steps.cue: Hexagon formed, towers appear at the wall
steps.rule: Make the star: north and south swap, north-east and north-west swap, south-east and south-west keep their side. Run out and stand in the tower on your new spoke.

steps.title: Drop the puddles in an L
steps.cue: Luminous Hammer puddles start dropping on you
steps.rule: Drop your five puddles while walking an L: in from your wall toward the centre, then turn to the cardinal clockwise of you (the west player turns north, the east player south).

steps.title: Towers done: meet your group
steps.rule: Split four and four: the three who took north towers go to the north wall, the three in south towers to the south wall. The west puddle player joins north, the east one south.

steps.title: Puddles done: join your group
steps.rule: Walk to your group at the wall, a little clockwise of its cardinal: just east of north, or just west of south.

steps.title: Step clockwise for the orbs
steps.rule: Stay with your group and slide a step clockwise along the wall, just east of north or just west of south.

steps.title: Dodge the first orbs
steps.cue: The first set of orbs explodes
steps.rule: If the orb on your cardinal is in the first set, your group moves fast, about three wall notches clockwise of the cardinal. If it isn't, your group holds about two notches clockwise.

steps.title: Dodge the second orbs
steps.rule: Swap paces: the group whose orb went first steps back into where it exploded (about two notches clockwise), the other group moves on to three notches clockwise before its own orb goes off.

steps.title: Two stacks: soak the centre tower
steps.rule: Check your Lightsteeped. With two stacks, go into the centre tower. Everyone else waits about 6m out: the group whose orb went first on its cardinal, the other group a little clockwise of its own.

steps.title: Banish spreads or pairs
steps.rule: Four orbs: spread to your clock spot about 8m out, MT north, OT east, H2 south, H1 west, R1 north-west, R2 north-east, M2 south-east, M1 south-west. One orb: DPS keep their intercard and each support joins one: MT with R1, OT with R2, H1 with M1, H2 with M2.

steps.title: Clock spots for the proteans
steps.rule: Everyone back to their own clock spot, about 8m out, for the eight protean cones.
